releaseNotes: The Messaging Client can now be fully popped out into its own window. Every pop-out (Messaging Client, Campaign Tracker, Archetype Builder, Reference Tables) has a Redock button. Login fixes: an email address can only be used by one account, usernames must be unique, the login button always shows the signed-in username, you can sign in with email or username, and messages are delivered to the correct account.
